Name: BigID
Author: BigID - mhebrard@bigid.com
Description:
The [BigID](https://bigid.com/data-security-posture-management/) solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to ingest BigID DSPM cases, classifier inventory, data source context, and affected catalog objects into Microsoft Sentinel, with a normalizing KQL parser (BigIDDSPMCases), an interactive DSPM Posture & Case Triage Workbook, and an on-demand 1,000-object evidence Playbook.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

a. [Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) and Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/create-codeless-connector)

b. [Azure Logic Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/logic-apps/logic-apps-overview)
